query:
SELECT pl.limit_key  AS "limit_key!",
                   pl.max_value  AS "max_value!"
            FROM subscriptions s
            JOIN subscription_plans sp ON sp.id = s.plan_id
            JOIN plan_limits        pl ON pl.plan_id = sp.id
            WHERE s.agency_id = $1
              AND s.status IN ('active', 'trialing')
